```{r setup,message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
```

```{r}
master <- read_csv("../data/processed/master_dataset.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    rural_urban = factor(rural_urban, levels = c("Rural", "Urban")),

    drd_category = factor(drd_category,
      levels = c(
        "LSOAs never ranked in top 50 most deprived",
        "LSOAs sometimes in the top 50 most deprived",
        "LSOAs often in the top 50 most deprived",
        "LSOAs in Deep-rooted deprivation"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE)
  )

```

```{r drd_crosstab}
# Number of rural, urban LSOAs in each DRD category
table(master$drd_category, master$rural_urban)
```

```{r drd_pct}
# row percentage-share of each category in rural and urban
prop.table(
  table(master$drd_category, master$rural_urban),
  margin = 1
) %>%
  round(3) * 100

```
```{r rural_deep_rooted}

master %>%
  filter(drd_category == "LSOAs in Deep-rooted deprivation",
         rural_urban  == "Rural") %>%
  select(lsoa_name, la_name, ruc_name,
         wimd_2025_rank, income_rank, access_rank, housing_rank)


```

```{r invisible_lsoas}
# never enter DRD tracking
master %>%
  filter(rural_urban == "Rural",
         access_rank <= 192,    # worst 10% on access
         wimd_2025_rank > 50) %>%  # but not overall top 50
  summarise(
    count               = n(),
    median_overall_rank = median(wimd_2025_rank, na.rm=TRUE),
    median_access_rank  = median(access_rank,    na.rm=TRUE),
    median_income_rank  = median(income_rank,    na.rm=TRUE)
  )


```


```{r invisible_by_la}
# LAs have most invisible rural LSOAs
master %>%
  filter(rural_urban == "Rural", access_rank <= 192, wimd_2025_rank > 50) %>%
  count(la_name, sort=TRUE)


```

```{r mechanism_proof}
# structural proof- access deprivation alone vs income deprivation 
master %>%
  filter(rural_urban == "Rural") %>%
  mutate(dep_type = case_when(
    access_rank <= 383 & income_rank <= 383 ~ "Both access AND income",
    access_rank <= 383 & income_rank >  383 ~ "Access deprived only",
    access_rank >  383 & income_rank <= 383 ~ "Income deprived only",
    TRUE                                    ~ "Neither"
  )) %>%
  group_by(dep_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n                   = n(),
    median_overall_rank = median(wimd_2025_rank, na.rm=TRUE),
    pct_worst20_overall = round(100 * mean(wimd_2025_rank <= 383), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(median_overall_rank)


```

```{r drd_volatility}
# rank stability across 20 years by DRD category
# SD across 6 iterations
master %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(rank_sd = sd(c_across(c(wimd_2025_rank, wimd_2019_rank, wimd_2014_rank,
                                  wimd_2011_rank, wimd_2008_rank, wimd_2005_rank)),
                      na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(drd_category) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median_sd = round(median(rank_sd, na.rm=TRUE), 0), .groups="drop")

```


```{r drd_domain_profile}
# Domain profile by DRD category- 2025 ranks only
master %>%
group_by(drd_category, rural_urban) %>%
  summarise(
    n             = n(),
    median_income = median(income_rank,  na.rm=TRUE),
    median_access = median(access_rank,  na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n >= 2) %>%
  arrange(drd_category, rural_urban)

```

```{r}
top50 <- master %>% slice_min(wimd_2025_rank, n = 50)

top50 %>%
  count(rural_urban) %>%
  mutate(pct = paste0(round(100 * n / 50, 0), "%"))
```


```{r}
top50 %>%
  select(wimd_2025_rank, lsoa_name, la_name,
         rural_urban, income_rank, employment_rank, access_rank) %>%
  arrange(wimd_2025_rank)
```

```{r}
dom_cols <- c("income_rank","employment_rank","health_rank",
              "education_rank","access_rank","housing_rank")

list(
  "Top 50 Rural (n=2)"      = top50 %>% filter(rural_urban == "Rural"),
  "Top 50 Urban (n=48)"     = top50 %>% filter(rural_urban == "Urban"),
  "All Rural Wales (n=561)" = master %>% filter(rural_urban == "Rural")
) %>%
  map_dfr(~summarise(.x, across(all_of(dom_cols),
                                ~round(median(.x, na.rm=TRUE), 0))),
          .id = "group")
```

```{r}
domain_cols   <- c("wimd_2025_rank","income_rank","employment_rank",
                   "health_rank","education_rank","access_rank",
                   "housing_rank","community_safety_rank","physical_env_rank")
domain_labels <- c("WIMD Overall","Income (22%)","Employment (20%)",
                   "Health (15%)","Education (14%)","Access (10%)",
                   "Housing (9%)","Community Safety (5%)","Physical Env (5%)")

map2_dfr(domain_cols, domain_labels, function(col, label) {
  t50 <- master %>% slice_min(.data[[col]], n = 50)
  tibble(domain         = label,
         rural_in_top50 = sum(t50$rural_urban == "Rural"),
         urban_in_top50 = sum(t50$rural_urban == "Urban"))
})
```



```{r drd_visualization}
master %>%
  count(rural_urban, drd_category) %>%
  group_by(rural_urban) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rural_urban, y = pct, fill = drd_category)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.55) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(pct > 1.5, paste0(n, "\n(", pct, "%)"),"  ")),
            position = position_stack(vjust=0.5),
            size=3.2, colour="white", fontface="bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#74add1","#f46d43","#d73027","#4d0000")) +
  labs(title = "Deep-Rooted Deprivation: Rural vs Urban LSOAs",
       subtitle = "559 of 561 rural LSOAs have never appeared in the top 50 most deprived in 20 years",
       x=NULL, y="% of LSOAs", fill="DRD Category",
       caption = "Source: WIMD 2025 DRD (Welsh Government); RUC 2021 (ONS).") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
  theme(legend.position="bottom", plot.title=element_text(face="bold")) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow=2))


```
